nodes.text: Explicit version graph flows from app invocation into source-bound Reader validator; absence/mismatch cannot silently pass.
Metadata retains version binding and registration hashes generation version artifact and current resolver/projector code.
Unversioned three-field lineage contexts remain supported without inferring producer paths.
Thirteen synthetic E2E tests traverse real build/publication/query/final gates, with only finite fixture model/runtime responses.
Missing/wrong binding or failed new build leaves previous published config/index unchanged; human selection followed by source change is held.
This does not approve annual-document version policy, immutable lineage validator behavior, real model/GUI/packaging, or V1 final acceptance.
